title: Frequently Asked Questions
subtitle: Everything you need to know about working with Branding Hours
description: Answers to the most common questions about our digital marketing, SEO, paid media, and web development services. Still have a question? Email contact@brandinghours.com.

questions.question: What does a digital marketing agency do?
questions.answer: A digital marketing agency helps businesses grow online through services like SEO, paid advertising, social media, content, and website development. Branding Hours combines all of these under one roof — planning strategy, running campaigns, and tracking results so your brand reaches the right audience and turns visitors into customers.

questions.question: How much do digital marketing services cost?
questions.answer: Cost depends on your goals, the services you need, and how competitive your market is. We build custom packages rather than one-size-fits-all pricing, so you only pay for what moves your business forward. Contact us for a free consultation and a transparent quote tailored to your budget.

questions.question: How long does it take to rank on Google?
questions.answer: Most SEO campaigns show measurable improvement within 3 to 6 months, with stronger results in 6 to 12 months for competitive industries. Technical fixes and local SEO often work faster. Paid ads, by contrast, can drive traffic immediately while your organic rankings build over time.

questions.question: What is performance marketing?
questions.answer: Performance marketing is advertising where you pay for measurable results — clicks, leads, or sales — rather than just exposure. It covers the full funnel from awareness to conversion across Google Ads, Meta Ads, and more, with every rupee tracked against clear KPIs so you always know your return on investment.

questions.question: Should I invest in SEO or paid ads?
questions.answer: Both serve different goals. Paid ads deliver fast, predictable traffic and are ideal for launches and promotions. SEO builds lasting, compounding visibility that keeps working without ongoing ad spend. Most brands get the best results by combining the two — we help you balance them based on your budget and timeline.

questions.question: What is the difference between SEO, AEO, and GEO?
questions.answer: SEO ranks your website on search engines like Google. AEO (Answer Engine Optimization) gets your content cited by AI answer tools like ChatGPT and Perplexity. GEO (Generative Engine Optimization) structures your presence so generative AI recommends your brand. Together they make you visible across every form of modern search.

questions.question: Do you work with businesses outside India?
questions.answer: Yes. While we're based in Ghaziabad, India, we work with brands across the US, UK, Canada, and Australia. Our team coordinates across time zones and tailors strategy, language, and market positioning to each region so your campaigns feel local wherever your customers are.

questions.question: How do you measure the success of a campaign?
questions.answer: We tie every campaign to clear metrics — organic traffic, keyword rankings, leads, conversions, cost per acquisition, and return on ad spend. You receive regular reports in plain language showing exactly what's working, what we're improving next, and how the numbers connect to real business growth.

questions.question: Which industries does Branding Hours work with?
questions.answer: We've delivered results across e-commerce, real estate, healthcare, SaaS and technology, education, hospitality, finance, and professional services. Our strategies adapt to your niche, competition, and goals — so whether you're a local business or a scaling brand, the approach fits your market.

questions.question: How do I get started with Branding Hours?
questions.answer: Simply book a free consultation through our contact page, email contact@brandinghours.com, or message us on WhatsApp at +91 9871741353. We'll learn about your business, audit your current presence, and recommend a clear, no-obligation plan to help you grow.
